definitions.definition: An informal social gathering, usually in a natural outdoor setting, to which the participants bring their own food and drink.
The meal eaten at such a gathering.

definitions.definition: (obsolete) An entertainment at which each person contributed some dish to a common table.
A cut of pork from the shoulder area (above the front leg) of a pig.
